O.outcome_detail: order of unpacked stacked subscripts and preservation of subscript information

cells.quote: These tests indicate that the unstacking rules, while likely less reliable than the rest of our subscript system, should at least give Gemini a fighting chance to preserve the information in board-written stacked subscripts in real instructional videos.
cells.note: The finding is reported in the wiki entry; the corresponding Section 5.5 study passage is not included in the supplied study text. The entry states that the first transcription matched the instructions, while the second reversed the order, with subscript information accessibly preserved in both; no effect size was reported.

O.outcome_detail: compilation without errors and PDF/UA-2 and ISO 32005 validation

cells.quote: The v6m preamble and system instructions produced high-quality transcriptions that compiled without error and passed the PDFix PDFUA-2-ISO32005 validation test in 16 out of 17 successive transcription tests involving 16 different test videos.
cells.note: The study reports a 16/17 pass rate but specifies no comparison condition, so the contrast direction and design cannot be coded.

O.outcome_detail: robust and accessible transcription of board-written subscript configurations

cells.quote: "Overall, our v6m subscript system has enabled Gemini to robustly and accessibly transcribe a reasonably wide range of board-written subscript configurations."
cells.note: This sentence appears in the wiki entry, not in the supplied study-text excerpt. The entry reports qualitative inspection of 17 test PDFs and source files and no effect size; the study excerpt does not specify a comparison condition.
